arguments.body: Hello, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine and for offering to replace it. Please don't buy or install a new one yet: a replacement machine needs the landlord's consent, and we also need to check whether the current LG belongs to the landlord. We've asked them and will update you by 30 July. If you can, please send a photo of the machine, its model label and any error code. Meanwhile, please leave the old machine unplugged.
